name: Simfarm
author: ryuhzk
description: Watch and drive the iOS, Android, and WeChat simulators running on a Mac, from the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Booted simulator count, and a click to open the device panel.

schema.label: Simfarm URL
schema.description: Where simfarm is reachable, e.g. https://your-mac.tailnet.ts.net:8801 or http://100.x.y.z:8801. An https:// URL is opened directly. A plain http:// one is tunnelled through the SSH host below, because browsers only enable the video decoder on a secure origin and 127.0.0.1 counts as one.

schema.label: SSH host (only for plain http)
schema.description: An ssh target or ~/.ssh/config alias for the Mac, e.g. user@host. Leave empty when the URL above is https.

schema.label: Local port for the tunnel
schema.description: This end of the tunnel. Change it if something else already owns 8801. Ignored for https.
